sections.content: You know *es importante que* + subjunctive from A2 Unit 27. The same pattern works with *es necesario que* and *hace falta que*: the verb after *que* is in the present subjunctive (*reduzcamos, reciclemos, protejamos*). Here you use it to say what must be done for the environment.

items.spanish: Es necesario que reduzcamos el consumo de agua.
items.english: It is necessary that we reduce water consumption.
It is important that we recycle more.

items.spanish: Hace falta que protejamos las especies.
items.english: We need to protect the species.

items.spanish: Es necesario que la ciudad mejore el transporte público.
items.english: It is necessary that the city improve public transport.

sections.content: For a general need use the infinitive: *Hace falta reducir el consumo.* When you say who must act, use *que* + subjunctive: *Hace falta que reduzcamos el consumo.*
